data.one_liner: Responsive grid system for Flutter with row/column, list, and staggered list widgets
data.what_it_does: Provides Bootstrap‑style grid layout widgets (ResponsiveGridRow/Col), a responsive list that auto‑fits items, and a staggered list. Includes utilities for responsive widgets, builders, and value selection based on breakpoints.
use_when: Need a flexible grid layout that adapts to multiple screen sizes
Want to avoid manual MediaQuery calculations for grid widths
Need a responsive list that automatically adjusts item count per row
avoid_when: You only need a simple GridView or ListView without breakpoint logic
You prefer a custom grid implementation with more control over layout logic
strengths: Supports custom breakpoints and segment counts
Offers staggered grid for variable item heights
weaknesses: No support for scrolling direction changes or complex nested grids
No built‑in theming or styling beyond basic layout
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, call initScaling() if using scale() function, optionally override breakpoints before runApp

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar responsive utilities and grid system with more extensive breakpoint handling

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers responsive widgets and builders but without grid layout

alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler size utilities but no grid widgets
